visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A Shiba Inu dog with orange and white fur is shown from a back perspective, sitting calmly on a light-colored marble floor in a modern indoor living room setting. It is staring intently at a black tablet propped up on a low coffee table with a white marble top. The tablet displays a scene from a Chinese period drama featuring a bearded male character with a golden crown lying in bed and speaking. The lighting is warm and domestic, illuminating the dog's ears and the back of its head clearly. (2) The dog suddenly raises its right front paw and strikes the tablet screen multiple times in a rapid scratching motion. The camera remains static throughout this action. A yellow, stylized variety text overlay reading 'Combo' pops up near the dog's right ear to emphasize the repetitive movement. A hand briefly enters the frame from the side to stabilize the tablet as the dog continues to paw at the screen.

Background music consists of tense orchestral strings and low-frequency percussion hits in a minor key, creating a cinematic sense of drama. The ambient noise floor is low and clean, typical of an indoor home environment. (2) A series of quick, sharp percussive thuds and scratching sounds occur, representing the physical impact of a paw against a hard screen surface. These transient sounds overlap with the ongoing dramatic male speech and the swelling orchestral music. The voice becomes even more strained and loud as the musical tension peaks before the audio ends abruptly.
